name: Staggering Melancholy, Mass
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 4, cleric/oracle 4, lathspell 4, mesmerist 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

Target one creature/level, no two of which may be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as staggering melancholy except as noted above.
